title: MARS-X Jezero data handover inventory
status: repository-inspected; integration verified by code/assets, not inferred from file presence

coordinateContract.latitude: planetocentric unless a source label states otherwise
coordinateContract.warning: These are not Earth WGS 84 coordinates. Dataset projections differ; matching dimensions or nominal extents do not establish alignment.

integrationDefinitions.flutterIntegrated: Declared in pubspec.yaml and loaded by Flutter provider/screen code.
integrationDefinitions.webIntegrated: Imported/fetched by React app code for rendering/planning.
integrationDefinitions.backendIntegrated: Read by backend runtime code. This does not imply scientific coordinate/NoData correctness.
integrationDefinitions.available_unintegrated: Present and metadata/source prepared, but not consumed by runtime app code.

datasets.name: HiRISE controlled DTM source image
datasets.format: PDS3 IMG, 32-bit floating-point elevation samples with embedded label
datasets.source: USGS Astrogeology controlled HiRISE DTM / PDS label; item data/catalogue/stac_DTEEC_045994_1985_046060_1985_U01.json
datasets.crs: Mars 2015 sphere, planetocentric/equirectangular, east-positive; see embedded PDS label and generated metadata
datasets.units: metres elevation above Mars equipotential datum (generated terrain binary stores decimetres)
datasets.nodata: Source label-defined; resampled planning product uses Int16 -32768
datasets.consumerReady: source/archive for regeneration, not directly read by runtime
limitations: Small landing-area footprint only
No whole-crater coverage
Do not infer rock-scale hazards from the resampled planning grid

datasets.name: HiRISE-derived terrain display and planner grid
datasets.format: 480x304 Int16 little-endian decimetres (-32768 NoData) for display; 120x76 planning grid; generated web grid encoded in TypeScript
datasets.source: Derived by data/build_dem.py from the HiRISE D3 PDS3 image
datasets.crs: Local Mars 2015 sphere/equirectangular, east-positive longitude, planetocentric latitude; stored projected grid center/steps in jezero-dem.json and JEZERO_META
datasets.coverage: About 4.11 x 2.65 km around 77.4509°E, 18.4446°N; source footprint broader than generated resampled map window
datasets.resolution: Input about 1.0097 m/pixel; display grid approximately 8.6 m spacing; planner cells approximately 34.25 x 34.91 m (metadata cellM 34.58 m)
datasets.units: metres elevation; binary integer units decimetres
datasets.nodata: -32768 in display binary; generated planning grid metadata says 406 NoData cells

integration.flutter: integrated_asset; rootBundle provider and terrain screen
integration.web: integrated; src/engine.ts imports src/jezeroGrid.ts and Terrain3D fetches public/jezero-dem.bin

datasets.consumerReady: frontend can render current local patch; backend currently loads it but its loader does not mask -32768 before averaging
limitations: Not crater-wide
CRS-to-screen transform is local/custom
NoData propagation requires review, especially backend loader
No certified route-safety meaning

datasets.crs: Mars 2000 sphere; Equidistant Cylindrical, central meridian 0°, planetocentric standard parallel 18.4663°, metres
datasets.coverage: Manifest catalogue bounds 76.99–78.58°E, 17.58–19.29°N; actual bounds recorded in source metadata/manifest
datasets.units: metres elevation; valid range in manifest -3504.6453 to -475.8408 m

integration.web: not_integrated; web terrain remains local HiRISE

datasets.consumerReady: Flutter loads the packaged 100 m CTX grid with its Mars transform and NoData mask; source CTX raster remains available for higher-resolution processing
limitations: 20 m source and 100 m aggregated route grid cannot resolve all small hazards
stereo-derived elevation, some extended areas localized to MOLA
seam, overlap and HiRISE alignment validation still required
not integrated in web or backend runtime

datasets.name: USGS Mars 2020 Jezero CTX orthomosaic
datasets.source: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / PDS; see data/metadata/jezero_wide_manifest.json
datasets.crs: Mars 2000 sphere; Equidistant Cylindrical, central meridian 0°, planetocentric standard parallel 18.4663°, metres
datasets.nodata: NoData not established from raster tag in this handover; preserve source mask/metadata and do not fill uncovered DEM margins
datasets.consumerReady: Flutter displays the 100 m aligned grayscale overview; the original full-resolution image remains a source file
limitations: Large source raster; not packaged whole in the app
NoData/uncovered image margin remains transparent
Imagery is not used for elevation or route costs

datasets.name: THEMIS-derived thermal inertia raster family
datasets.format: GeoTIFF; source 890x890; Mars TM 566x595; app-EQC 563x594; Float32, 1 band
datasets.source: Edwards & Buz (2021), Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4931348; source file provenance/checksum not fully supplied
datasets.crs: Source simple cylindrical Mars (lon0=0, lat_ts=0); processed Mars TM (lon0=77.5°); app-EQC (lon0=77.5°, standard parallel 18.4°); Mars sphere radius 3,396,190 m
datasets.coverage: Source projected bounds 4564100–4653100 m E, 1052100–1141100 m N; processed variants clipped to USGS SIM 3464 boundary; only about 55% valid on cleaned outputs
datasets.units: J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 thermal inertia; not temperature
datasets.nodata: 0; manifest valid fractions: source 62.36%, TM 55.02%, app-EQC 55.35%
datasets.consumerReady: prototype reader can consume app-EQC with 0 transparent/unknown, but alignment not scientifically signed off
limitations: Processing script/source archive identity absent
Pixel alignment to D8 and CTX not independently validated
Not current temperature

datasets.name: USGS SIM 3464 categorical geologic unit rasters
datasets.format: GeoTIFF UInt16, one band; Mars TM 566x595 and app-EQC 563x594
datasets.crs: Mars SIM 3464 Transverse Mercator; app-EQC project-local Mars equirectangular centered at 77.5°E, standard parallel 18.4°; Mars sphere 3,396,190 m
datasets.coverage: SIM 3464 map boundary; smaller than CTX crater-wide DEM coverage
datasets.units: integer unit_id lookup key, not a score
datasets.consumerReady: app-EQC raster and lookup can support a prototype categorical preview; not sign-off for CTX overlay
limitations: Rasterization process not independently reproduced
Alignment to D6/CTX/HiRISE not validated
No route weight should be inferred from unit IDs

datasets.name: USGS SIM 3464 GeoPackage source and app-projection vectors
datasets.format: GeoPackage vector layers (units polygons, contacts lines, surface-feature polygons, location points, linear-feature lines, boundary/nomenclature as present in package)
datasets.source: USGS SIM 3464 source geodatabase; transformation/repair pipeline not supplied in D8 handoff
datasets.crs: First is Mars 2000 sphere Transverse Mercator lon0=77.5°; second stores project-local Mars EQC parameters but generic CRS naming
datasets.coverage: SIM 3464 map boundary, not full CTX DEM
datasets.resolution: Publication scale 1:75,000; vector geometry, no pixel resolution
datasets.units: Projected metres in GPKG coordinate spaces
datasets.consumerReady: backend can inspect/query with GeoPackage-capable GDAL/OGR; frontend should use app-EQC only after transform QA or request backend reprojection
limitations: No independent geometry/alignment QA
Map coverage must be shown separately
Regional interpretation, not obstacle-scale data

datasets.name: USGS SIM 3464 longitude/latitude GeoJSON exports (cleaned D8)
datasets.format: GeoJSON FeatureCollections; polygons, lines, points as filename indicates
datasets.crs: Mars east-positive longitude / planetocentric latitude per project inventory; GeoJSON files themselves lack explicit Mars CRS member, and RFC-style consumers may assume Earth WGS 84
datasets.coverage: SIM 3464 regional coverage (exact coverage polygon in processed sim3464_map_coverage.geojson)
datasets.resolution: 1:75,000 source map; 8 m simplification applies to processed counterparts, not established here for D8 cleaned folder
datasets.units: Coordinates in degrees; source lengths/areas in attribute units as preserved
datasets.consumerReady: not directly safe for generic web GeoJSON; use Mars-aware parser or GeoPackage
limitations: No embedded CRS metadata
Large geometry files
Coverage smaller than DEM

datasets.name: USGS SIM 3464 clipped processed GeoJSON layers
datasets.format: Mars-aware FeatureCollections; Polygon/MultiPolygon, line, point layers
datasets.source: USGS SIM 3464, transformed by data/build_jezero_vectors.py and clipped to CTX DEM bounds; 8 m display simplification
datasets.crs: marsCoordinateSystem extension: Mars 2000 sphere, east-positive 0–360 longitude, planetocentric latitude; coordinates are not Earth WGS 84
datasets.coverage: Clipped to 76.997437–78.582563°E, 17.580520–19.290187°N; SIM source map coverage is narrower and explicitly polygonized
datasets.units: Mars geographic degrees; lengths/areas in source properties may be source-projection values
datasets.nodata: Not applicable; missing map coverage is unknown, not feature absence
datasets.consumerReady: backend/frontend can read with Mars-aware coordinate contract; frontend should avoid rendering all large polygons at once
limitations: USGS mapped layers are not exhaustive outside coverage polygon
Label anchors are text positions, not feature centers
Not yet in Flutter assets

datasets.name: FU Berlin Jezero WFS reference layers
datasets.format: GeoJSON-formatted WFS responses; coordinates remain projected metres and are not RFC 7946 longitude/latitude despite the extension
datasets.source: ESA/Freie Universität Berlin Jezero interactive map WFS; https://maps.planet.fu-berlin.de/jezero/
datasets.crs: EPSG:49911, Mars 2015 Ographic / Equirectangular, central meridian 0, Mars sphere radius 3396190 m; raw files use projected x/y metres
datasets.coverage: Map layer coverage varies; lake/channel/panorama subset is used by requested_landmark_register
datasets.units: Projected metres in raw files; derived register uses east-positive degrees and planetocentric latitude
datasets.nodata: Source layers have sparse/empty attributes; channel lines are unnamed
datasets.consumerReady: Use only through the build_landmark_register.py conversion or reproject with the Mars CRS definition; do not parse raw projected coordinates as degrees
limitations: WFS layer schema and source coverage vary
Channel lines lack name attributes
Paleo-lake polygon is one possible level reconstruction
Panorama points are observation viewpoints

datasets.name: 29-name requested landmark register
datasets.kind: mixed research register / GeoJSON with nullable geometries
datasets.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, east-positive longitude, planetocentric latitude
datasets.coverage: Jezero requested names within or potentially near DEM; null coordinates mean location is unresolved
datasets.units: Degrees when coordinates available; scientific significance textual, separate from route safety
datasets.nodata: Null coordinates/geometries deliberately indicate unresolved location; 15 of 29 records have geometry and 14 remain null, including two mapped regions with no representative point
datasets.consumerReady: Backend can parse as a Mars-aware catalogue now; frontend can prototype the 15 non-null geometries after CRS handling, GeometryCollection support, and null filtering
limitations: 14 of 29 names have null geometry
Two mapped regions have no representative point
Geology geometry is clipped to SIM 3464/DEM coverage
FU Berlin channel attribution is spatial because WFS line features are unnamed
Panorama and rover/sample positions are not necessarily feature centers
Some informal names remain incompletely verified
No terrain-hazard features are supplied

datasets.name: Published reference points and USGS label anchors
datasets.source: Published Perseverance touchdown, USGS Gazetteer crater center, USGS SIM 3464 label annotation anchors
datasets.crs: Mars-aware metadata: east-positive longitude, planetocentric latitude on Mars 2000 sphere
datasets.coverage: DEM bounds declared; point subset only
datasets.resolution: Point locations; map-label anchors are annotation centroids, not feature centers

integration.flutter: integrated_asset; provider parses and crater-wide map renders within CTX grid

datasets.consumerReady: Flutter displays point and label-anchor features in the Mars-aware crater-wide map
limitations: Only 10 points
No full requested landmark coverage
Belva and valley anchors must not be treated as feature centers/boundaries

datasets.name: Perseverance PDS PLACES per-sol localizations
datasets.format: PDS CSV source; GeoJSON 531 unique per-sol points in CTX footprint
datasets.source: PDS Mars 2020 Rover PLACES Release 16, best_interp.csv
datasets.crs: Mars longitude east-positive and planetocentric latitude; GeoJSON custom Mars extension
datasets.coverage: 531 sols (0–1897) with positions in CTX DEM footprint; Flutter displays these in the crater-wide CTX view
datasets.resolution: Per-sol archived positions; source does not provide numeric positional error
datasets.units: Longitude/latitude degrees; elevation in metres in properties
datasets.nodata: Not applicable; omitted PDS localization rows mean gaps

integration.flutter: integrated_asset; points loaded and locally visible stops drawn

datasets.consumerReady: Flutter local point layer available; backend can consume processed GeoJSON with Mars coordinate handling
limitations: best_interp localized/interpolated archive product
Not exact wheel track or camera pose
PDS notes omit some ROVER,n,0 rows

datasets.name: Perseverance traverse display segments
datasets.source: Derived from PDS PLACES Release 16 localizations by data/build_jezero_vectors.py
datasets.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, east-positive longitude, planetocentric latitude
datasets.coverage: CTX DEM clipped positions; gaps longer than two sols remain disconnected
datasets.resolution: Connects available per-sol positions; not a surveyed continuous track
datasets.units: Coordinates degrees; sol identifiers in attributes
datasets.nodata: Gaps retained, not interpolated across long intervals
datasets.consumerReady: readable for historical context with explicit display-only warning

No numeric position-error values
Do not use as route safety/surface traversability

datasets.name: Three Forks sample-drop event table
datasets.source: PDS Mars 2020 Three Forks Depot sample-drop bundle
datasets.coverage: Events at Three Forks depot; coordinates absent
limitations: Must not infer individual tube coordinates from imagery or nearby rover position

processingScripts.purpose: Read original HiRISE PDS3 IMG and produce web/mobile terrain binaries and metadata; requires NumPy and PDS image label.
Transform/clip USGS SIM 3464 and PDS PLACES to processed GeoJSON; requires pyogrio, pyproj, shapely and downloaded raw source files.
Regenerate 29-name JSON/GeoJSON/CSV register; preserves unresolved coordinates as null.
Fetch raw USGS SIM 3464 / PDS landmark and rover source data; network required.
Query USGS/PDS catalogue endpoints and optionally download selected DTM inputs; network required.
Fetch/prepare MOLA context crop; inspect script arguments and outputs before running.
HiRISE source acquisition helper; inspect script arguments before running.
Read-only file, GeoJSON, geometry, coordinate, GeoTIFF-header and GeoPackage metadata checks; writes validation JSON report.

reproduction.vectors: python data/fetch_landmark_sources.py (if raw sources missing), then python data/build_jezero_vectors.py
reproduction.craterWideRasters: Already downloaded under data/raw/JezeroWide; no app pyramid/tile builder currently exists.
